purpose: Official data-citation mapping for the existing nine frozen CMIP6 SImon siconc stores; no new analysis.
member_evidence_boundary: The member labels and original store versions are taken from the frozen source manifest. Official DataCite abstracts explicitly define each experiment collection as including all published datasets below the experiment DRS prefix, including member/table/variable/grid/version fields. This verifies the citation-level mapping; it is not an independent file-level availability or checksum audit.
version_policy: Use each original source-store version in the data citation and Table S6. Current DataCite record versions are recorded separately; they do not change the version actually analysed.

source_notes: DataCite current creator spelling is used (Bi, Daohua; Domingues, Catia M.). The DKRZ 2021 table has older spellings (Bi, Doahua; Domingues, Catia).
BCC-CSM2-MR is the DRS source_id; official data titles use BCC-CSM2MR. Preserve each exactly.
Original ESGF experiment DOIs are selected. IPCC DDC 10.26050/WDCC/AR6 archive DOIs describe archived holdings and are not substituted for the frozen GCS source stores.
